ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'created_at') because whatsappUrl(lastTxn=null, umkm, null) is executed on POS render before any sale. Radix Dialog's <a href={whatsappUrl(...)}> is evaluated by React eagerly. Fixed by adding null-guards in buildReceiptText/buildReceiptHTML/printReceipt in receipt.js.

critical_code_review_comments: receipt.js buildReceiptText/buildReceiptHTML previously assumed txn is truthy; now null-guarded. Same defensive coding should be applied whenever nullable state is passed to render-time helpers.

POS.jsx renders <a href={whatsappUrl(lastTxn,...)}> unconditionally inside Success Dialog; even though Radix Dialog typically unmounts children when open=false, the eager URL evaluation caused crash. Conditional render (`{lastTxn && <a ...>}`) would be safer.

rca of the issue: Root cause: POS.jsx line 266 renders `<a href={whatsappUrl(lastTxn, umkm, null)}>` inside the Success Dialog. React evaluates the `href` expression during render; when lastTxn is initially null (before any sale), whatsappUrl → buildReceiptText which accessed `txn.created_at` on null → TypeError bubbling up as 'Cannot read properties of null (reading \'created_at\')'. Reproduction: register a fresh UMKM → navigate to /app/pos → POS component throws before rendering. Mitigation applied: added `if (!txn) return "";` guards to buildReceiptText, buildReceiptHTML, and printReceipt in /app/frontend/src/lib/receipt.js. Verified fix: after edit, POS renders products list, checkout succeeds, print-receipt & wa-receipt buttons render, WhatsApp link contains properly encoded receipt text.
